title: Elephant Rumbles Travel Through the Ground Over 6 Kilometers

scenes.text: Their rumbles sit below 20 hertz, too low for humans to hear.
Sensors in Kenya picked up one rumble more than six kilometers away, through the ground.
Researchers think elephants feel the vibrations in their feet and bones.
Even a mock charge sends signals through the earth.
A message so deep you'd only feel it in your feet.

description:
